title: Scroll Performance Optimizations
content: RAF-based smoothing with passive event listeners. Damping factor 0.08 (8% per frame). Stops interpolation when diff < 0.0005.

title: Map Performance Optimizations
content: Plain object for zoomBlend (no Vue reactivity overhead). Capped pixel ratio at 2x max. Conditional anti-aliasing. powerPreference: high-performance.

title: Cloud Performance Optimizations
content: CSS calc() transforms (GPU-accelerated). contain: strict for isolation. CSS-only animations avoid JS overhead.

title: Label Performance Optimizations
content: Proximity check skipped when zoomed. Conditional label visibility updates.

title: Fog Performance Optimizations
content: Indexed for-loop instead of forEach for fog sprite animations.
